# Evaluations

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/evaluation`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/evaluation.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/evaluations/reports` | The latest completed scorecard per version and test set (newest version first). |  | 200 list of `ReportRow` |
| `GET` | `/v1/evaluators` | Evaluators |  | 200 list of `Manifest` |
| `POST` | `/v1/gates/agents/{agent}/check` | May `version` replace `baseline_version`? Needs a completed run on the test set's current cases that clears the pass rate and does not fall behind the live version. | `GateIn` | 200 `GateOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/runs` | List Runs |  | 200 list of `RunOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/runs` | Evaluate one version of an assistant (drafts too) on a test set. | `RunIn` | 202 `RunOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/runs/{run_id}` | Get Run |  | 200 `RunOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | Cancel Run |  | 200 `RunOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/runs/{run_id}/results` | Per-case answers and scores. |  | 200 list of `ResultOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/test-sets` | List Sets |  | 200 list of `SetOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/test-sets` | Create Set | `SetIn` | 201 `SetOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/test-sets/from-pack` | Start from the ready-made questions a Domain Pack ships with. | `PackSetIn` | 201 `SetOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}` | Get Set |  | 200 `SetOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}` | Patch Set | `SetPatch` | 200 `SetOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}` | Delete Set |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}/cases` | List Cases |  | 200 list of `CaseOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}/cases` | Add cases, e.g. | list of `CaseIn` | 201 list of `CaseOut` |
| `PUT` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}/cases/{case_id}` | Replace Case | `CaseIn` | 200 `CaseOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/test-sets/{set_id}/cases/{case_id}` | Delete Case |  | 204 |
